title: 台北捷運文湖線
summary: 以文湖線的都市中運量路網為背景，建立密站距、曲線與高架車站的縮尺營運實驗。課程從輪胎接觸和乘客舒適性延伸到進路互鎖及失去通訊後的安全狀態，對照班距縮短與折返瓶頸。
summaryEn: Use the Wenhu urban corridor to construct a scaled operational experiment with closely spaced stations, curves and elevated platforms. Begin with tyre contact and passenger comfort, then investigate route interlocking and the safe state after communication loss. Contrast shorter line headways with a terminal that cannot release routes quickly enough.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散與加速度斜坡與舒適性
stages.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss & Acceleration ramps and comfort
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」與「加速度斜坡與舒適性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rubber-tyre rolling loss" and "Acceleration ramps and comfort": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 膠輪變形造成遲滯能量損失，可用等效滾動阻力係數乘法向力估計阻力。胎壓、溫度和路面狀態都會改變係數；承載輪與導向輪的功能不同，不能用鋼輪系統的固定係數直接替代。 滾動阻力係數乘法向荷重得到阻力，再乘速度才是功率。輪胎壓力、溫度與變形影響係數；此模型沒有計入導向輪、風阻與加速能量，不能代表整車總耗電。 用相同輪載與速度比較輪胎滾動阻力功率，另列導向輪的功能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rubber deformation creates hysteretic energy loss, represented approximately by a rolling coefficient times normal force. Tyre pressure, temperature and running surface change the coefficient. Load-bearing and guidance wheels serve different functions, so a coefficient from a steel-wheel system cannot simply be substituted. Rolling-resistance coefficient times normal load gives force, and multiplying by speed gives power. Tyre inflation, temperature and deformation influence the coefficient. Guidance wheels, aerodynamic drag and acceleration are excluded, so this does not represent total vehicle electricity. Compare tyre rolling-resistance power at equal wheel load and speed, separately identifying guide-wheel functions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s；計算：rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s; calculation: rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膠輪與鋼輪的滾動阻力係數可以不經試驗直接互換」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rubber-tyre and steel-wheel rolling coefficients can be interchanged without testing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rubber-tyre rolling loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s；計算：rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW。敏感度：coefficient 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013332 1，其餘固定，結果為 119.988 kW。模型邊界：固定等效係數與定速；不含轉彎側滑、胎溫演化或驅動損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s; calculation: rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW. Sensitivity: coefficient, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013332 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 119.988 kW. Model boundary: Fixed effective coefficient and constant speed; curve scrub, tyre-temperature evolution and drive losses are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較相同負載下的牽引能量與胎溫，記錄胎壓、路面濕度及輪胎批次，並將導向輪磨耗獨立檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare traction energy and tyre temperature at equal load, record pressure, surface moisture and tyre batch, and inspect guidance-wheel wear separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較相同負載下的牽引能量與胎溫，記錄胎壓、路面濕度及輪胎批次，並將導向輪磨耗獨立檢查。 在已知輪載與穩定速度下量測牽引力，記錄胎壓及溫度，扣除可辨識的其他阻力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare traction energy and tyre temperature at equal load, record pressure, surface moisture and tyre batch, and inspect guidance-wheel wear separately. Measure tractive force at known normal load and steady speed, record tyre pressure and temperature, and remove identifiable other resistance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改變胎壓造成的假想滾阻係數，重算同速耗能，設計同時記錄輪溫與側向磨耗的對照試驗。 再以本單元 coefficient 的對照值重算 rolling_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change the hypothetical rolling coefficient associated with tyre pressure, recalculate energy at equal speed, and design a comparison recording tyre temperature and lateral wear. Also recalculate rolling_power for the alternative coefficient value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：胎壓偏低可能增加變形和熱累積，導向偏差又會造成額外磨耗；只看馬達電流無法區分兩種原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low tyre pressure can increase deformation and heat accumulation, while guidance misalignment adds wear; motor current alone cannot distinguish the causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rubber-tyre rolling loss"?

steps.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 胎壓偏低可能增加變形和熱累積，導向偏差又會造成額外磨耗；只看馬達電流無法區分兩種原因。 胎壓下降可能提高滾阻，需以同速同載量測判別變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low tyre pressure can increase deformation and heat accumulation, while guidance misalignment adds wear; motor current alone cannot distinguish the causes. Lower inflation can raise rolling resistance; compare measurements at equal speed and load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

stages.title: 車門交換與停站時間與速度限制轉換與預告距離

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 檢查小編組車門集中需求是否使某一門組決定停站尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Check whether concentrated demand in a short train makes one door group govern the dwell tail. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算

Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 267, to 267 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 25.90625 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車門交換與停站時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Door exchange and dwell time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instructionEn: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase load and reduce usable capacity for an ageing case, recalculate endurance, and identify evidence required beyond terminal-voltage readings. Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
